changelog:
## v1.9.38

- Summary Bar Layout 1 (1 Column Centered): Vertical stack featuring title, short description, clean urgency countdown digit blocks (hours, minutes, seconds only), regular & offer prices, and CTA button
- Summary Bar Layout 2 (2 Columns Split): Two-column layout with title, description, prices, and CTA button on the left, and countdown timer digit blocks on the right
- CTA Bounce Animation & Icon: Smooth subtle bounce animation on CTA button, customizable button text, and icon picker with before/after positioning
- Comprehensive Element Styling: Added extensive styling controls for container box (bg, border, radius, padding, margin), title, description, timer digits, prices, and CTA button
